name: cx-goal-one-rule~p3
task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Open the door, then take the box' is captured by hard Existence(target_picked_up) plus hard Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up); together they force door_open, so no Existence(door_open) is needed and none is present. 'Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' is a preference ('try not to'), and key_lost is already defined as the key being lost before the door was opened, so the ban is correctly a soft Absence(key_lost) rather than a Precedence. The machine's final state u3, rejecting state u1 on picking up the box before the door opens, and -1 soft penalty on key_lost all match these clauses.

texts: Open the door before picking up the target box.
Pick up the target box from the other room.
Try not to lose the key while the door is still closed.
